primary_reason_zh: 两版均把固定真实检查的反馈用于修改、保留后续执行用的 prompt/tool/workflow，并通过完整搜索反馈学习改进器。允许未完测父版本继续 draft，但采纳仅限完全合格的版本。D+H 保持任务模型权重不变；D/H/M 与外层 GVO 权重学习应标共演化，不因同时改权重排除。科学参数优化与 csvstat 输出代码案例本身是外部任务产物，不能单独充作 Harness 机制证据；范围依据是系统、prompt/workflow 分支和明确版本对象。

changes.detail: Method semantics retain immutable prompt/tool/workflow versions, fixed real evaluator, learned separate improver and carry/reset distinction; no scope reversal.

v1 optional KL/deployment settings were not all identified; v2 specifies fixed post-warm-up reference, beta_KL=.02, at most one joint SGD step, no momentum/weight decay or gradient clipping. v2 explicitly says exact-replay rho=1 and PPO clipping inactive; no update bound may be claimed.

v2 default lambda=mu=0: resource features and hard caps remain, no explicit cost penalty in reference returns. Costs still logged. Distinguish call-axis science budget, search tokens, serving tokens, training and total lifecycle.

SpecRSI main gains .48/.41/.52/.44/.42 -> .58/.52/.64/.55/.53; baseline means/SD/AUBC also change (including Janus IRP .30/31.5 -> .27/22.6). Do not silently rebind v1 summaries to these larger v2 results.

SpecRSI D/H/M 33.5/21.7/86.1/71.2 -> 35.6/23.7/87.3/72.9; D+H 30.1/16.3/79.9/64.7 -> 32.1/17.3/80.9/65.6. v2 D+H mean advantage is 3.475pp, rounded 3.48; D+H permits non-test data, not harness-only attribution.

v2 explicitly freezes shared Qwen-trained improver across ten scientific/twenty system backbones; held-out scientific scores are separate from search selection. Five seed means each aggregate three searches; do not claim fifteen independent seeds.

v1 tabulates rounds2-5; v2 reports 20-round Figure7 series and changes GVO-only reset/carry means from5.0/5.8 to4.60/5.68. These graph values were read as text/captions only, not checked against binary figure points or raw trajectories.

evidence.quote: An agent version c comprises executable code and persistent prompts, tools, and workflows.
Versions freeze prompts, tools, workflows, and permitted persistent state, including memory; only D/H/M permits model-parameter edits.
Carry/reset selects the next root separately from within-search acceptance, isolating learning from artifact retention.
This is a serving-token comparison, not a total-search-cost comparison.
Our core configuration runs direct checks only
Only the adopted version requires complete admissible evidence
so clipping is inactive and does not bound the update.
All comparisons match edit permissions, where MetaRSI-H and SpecRSI-H restrict updates to D+H (prompts, tool workflows, and non-test data) with frozen model weights
with held-out scores never used during search selection
Deployment runs a single frozen search, and forced continuations trigger no outer-loop updates.

numeric_check: Read all v2 semantic result tables and selected v1 aligned tables; checked displayed-mean arithmetic for main comparative/resource claims. No experimental rerun, no all-grid seed-level recomputation, no binary-figure validation.
limitations: Scope correctness is separate from independent reproducibility of large numerical revisions.
Five seeds, benchmark-derived subsets, task-specific protocols and public benchmarks constrain broad transfer claims.
D+H includes data editing, so its effect cannot be attributed to harness alone.
In-search best gain is nonnegative because root can be returned; this is not a guarantee of positive held-out or future-round improvement.
Default deployment is a frozen single search, not perpetual online GVO learning.
No monotonic or unbounded recursive improvement follows from finite tests.
Figures4-7/S1-S2 were not visually/numerically audited against raw curves; do not extract additional numbers from them.
